name: Educating Youth through Employment (EYE) summer program
org: Fairfax County Department of Family Services Workforce Development and Virginia Career Works Northern Region
what_you_do: Do workshops on getting ready for work, then a paid six week work experience matched to your interests. Common jobs listed include administrative assistant, social media assistant, tech intern, animal caretaker, research assistant and counselor-in-training.
who_can_apply: Youth ages 16 to 24. You must be legally allowed to work in the U.S. You must be getting services from a referring group or the WIOA Youth Program. You must want to find work. You must be able to work at least 20 hours a week and go to the workshops.
pay_detail: Paid work experience. The pay rate is not stated on the pages read.
deadline_text: The 2026 program ended with a recognition ceremony on Aug 14, 2026. The county says employer recruitment for the next summer begins in spring 2027. Youth sign-up dates for 2027 are not posted.
how_to_apply: You cannot apply alone. A sponsoring group or the WIOA Youth Program picks you. Email DFSEYE@fairfaxcounty.gov or see vcwnorthern.com/eye-programs/ to find a referring organization.
notes: Referral only. The county page also lists a WIOA Youth program for ages 17 to 24 who are out of school or close to graduating. In summer 2026, 133 youth worked with 100 local employers. Virginia work permit rules were not checked.
